_about: Titan overlay: replaces the Moon's milestone list (arrays replace). Ids are distinct from the Moon's and Mars's, because records are kept per campaign. Rules in rules/milestones.ts (T5 adds the Titan triggers: rules/titanTypes.ts TitanMilestoneTrigger, TitanZoneId).

_interface: money and rp are placeholders set with Owner A (copied from the Mars scale).
